name: Zotero ViewFlow
shortDescription: 在 Zotero 侧栏预览并复制格式化引文。
Preview and copy formatted references in Zotero’s item pane.
introduction: 面向阅读和写作时需要快速查看引用格式的用户，在条目侧栏展示参考文献与文内引文，并提供复制操作。
For readers and writers who need a quick formatting check: display references and in-text citations in the item pane and copy the formatted output.
githubDescription: Preview and copy formatted references in Zotero’s item pane. Part of Zotero Flow.
